clients.purpose: Explicit user-requested workspace refresh with one in-flight mutation and stable logical idempotency key.
clients.authority: Uses the generated browser operation partition. No automatic retries, refresh-on-read, intelligence computation or local permission decisions. Browser waiting is bounded to 30 seconds and aborted on unmount, without implying server cancellation; uncertain results require passive authoritative readback.
